Dialogs.Dialog: Don't be in such a rush.
Haha, you're in a good mood.
Hey, we made it to our destination, you know？
Looks like... this is the place.
That was a lot of fun. Makes me not want to leave...
Yeah... I feel the same way.
Guess we have no choice. Shall we head home？
Aw, no way. It's already this late...
I see... It's a shame, but we'd better head home.
Hate to call it a day, but shall we head home soon？
Yeah. It'd be bad if we stayed out too late.
Aw man, we should probably head home soon.
You're right. It's getting pretty late.
Hey, don't you think we should head home soon？
Oh, you're right. Let's head back, then.
So, what do we do from here？ As my boyfriend, I mean.
Here comes the important part. Time to test your boyfriend level.
Where I want to go is... Oh, you're my boyfriend, so you can tell, right？
So, what should we do now？
Have you thought about what we're doing next？
Where are we going first？ I'll leave it to you.
Now then, what are we gonna do？
Come on, what's the plan from here？
Where are we starting？ Personally... I'm fine with wherever.
What are we doing next？ Come on, out with it.
What are we doing next？ I'm expecting good things.
Next up is... Nah, never mind. You decide.
So, where are you planning to go next？
Thought about what to do next？ Don't put it on me.
Hey, what's next？ I can get my hopes up, right？
Picking a movie is tough, isn't it？ I'd like to watch whatever you want to see.
They're playing some pretty good stuff. Which one should we watch？
Which one should we pick？ I'll ask my boyfriend for a recommendation.
We're picking from these？ You can choose whichever you like.
Which one do you wanna see？ Pick whichever you like.
Which one do you wanna see？ I bet you'll pick that one.
Me？ What I want to see is...
None of these titles look all that great.
I have a favor to ask... Want to catch one more？
Hey, don't the other ones look pretty good too？
All right. Let's check out another one, then.
Hey. Can I be a little selfish right now？
I think I'm in the mood to see another movie...
Now I feel like seeing something else, too.
Don't you kind of feel like watching one more？
Now that you mention it, yeah, I kind of do.
Sounds good to me. I think I would've picked there too.
Yeah, sounds like fun. I'm all for it.
Aw man... That wasn't what I was expecting.
Hey... I'm getting hungry. Want to go grab some lunch？
I was getting hungry too. Let's go.
Let's go get lunch. I've been starving for a while.
I was getting hungry too. Let's go, then.
I'm hungry. I want to stop somewhere for food.
Want to grab some lunch somewhere？
Aren't you hungry？ Let's go get some lunch.
I'm too hungry to move. Can we stop for food now？
Hey... Want to go get some tea and relax for a bit？
I want to rest a little. Can we go relax somewhere？
Want to stop for tea around here？ I'm a little tired.
Is there a cafe around here？ I'd like to take a break.
Getting tired？ Let's take a breather.
Hey, let's go get some tea. I'm a little tired.
Got it. Let's take a break, then.
I kind of want to stop for tea. Can we？
Um... we're getting dinner, right？ I already told my family not to make me anything.
Of course. Let's go get something good.
We're getting dinner before heading back, right？ I figured you'd planned on it.
Hey, let's go get something to eat. I already told everyone at home I wouldn't need dinner tonight.
All right. Where do you want to eat, then？
It's getting pretty late. Want to go grab some dinner？
Oh, you're right. No wonder I'm so hungry.
I'm getting hungry. What about you？
Yeah, now that you mention it.
I'm starting to get hungry. Let's stop somewhere to eat.
I'm hungry too. Let's go, then.
This is the place, right？ Come on, let's go in.
Here we are. Come on, let's go inside.
We're here. Think we can get a table？ Let's hurry inside.
Don't we still have... plenty of time left？
I... don't really want to go home yet.
Since it's still early, I think I can stay out a little longer.
Then we've got time to check out somewhere else.
I was thinking... maybe we could go somewhere else too.
Where do you want to go, then？
Hey. Let's go hang out somewhere else too, okay？
True. Want to hang out a little longer, then？
Yeah, I'd like that. Where should we go？
Right？ Want to hang out a bit longer, then？
I'm all for that. Anywhere in particular you want to go？
All right. Want to stay out a little longer？
Yeah, but we shouldn't stay out too late...
Maybe, but your family'll worry if you're out too late, right？
We don't have enough time to hang out there.
Hmm... Yeah, I guess you're right.
We won't have enough time for that...
I'd like to go, but... I don't think we have enough time.
Listen... On second thought, never mind.
Why there...？ Hmm, actually, let's just forget it...
Why would you pick that？ Guess you didn't get the hint.
